info.title: ORQO API
info.description: The ORQO REST API: contacts, segments, campaigns, WhatsApp messages, conversations and analytics for one organization. Authenticate with `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. Guides: https://docs.orqo.site

get.description: The user the API token belongs to.
The organization the API token is bound to, with your role in it.

The organization's current plan, or `"data": null` when it has no
trial or subscription. Readable even without a subscription.

200.description: No trial or subscription: the organization must subscribe.

get.description:
The current user's in-app notifications for the token's organization,
newest first.

Newest first. Filter by `search` (name, email or phone), `segment_id`,
`tag` and `opt_in_whatsapp`.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Matches first name, last name, email or phone.

post.description:
Contacts are matched like everywhere else in ORQO: by `phone_e164`, or
by `email` when no phone is given. A new contact is `201`; an existing
one (or a deleted one with that number, which is restored) is updated
and returned with `200`. `custom_fields` keys must be contact fields
defined in Settings. Send an `Idempotency-Key` header to retry safely.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Any unique string up to 255 characters, such as a UUID. Retrying with the same key returns the first response (with `Idempotent-Replayed: true`) instead of acting twice.

custom_fields.description: Values keyed by contact field key (Settings → Contact fields).

200.description: An existing contact with this phone or email was updated.

patch.description:
Only the fields you send change. A `phone_e164` another contact already
has is `422 validation_failed`.

post.description: A dynamic segment is filled from its `rules` right away. Send an `Idempotency-Key` header to retry safely.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Any unique string up to 255 characters, such as a UUID. Retrying with the same key returns the first response (with `Idempotent-Replayed: true`) instead of acting twice.

post.description:
Creates a draft. Launch it with `POST /campaigns/{id}/launch`. Send an
`Idempotency-Key` header to retry safely.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Any unique string up to 255 characters, such as a UUID. Retrying with the same key returns the first response (with `Idempotent-Replayed: true`) instead of acting twice.

audience_ref.description: Segment id, tag name or CSV upload reference, depending on `audience_type`.

template.description: Approved WhatsApp template: name, language and component parameters.

payload.description: Extra message payload, such as header media.

schedule_at.description: ISO 8601 time to send at; omit to send on launch.

get.description: `stats` are recomputed from the recipients on every call.

patch.description:
Only draft and paused campaigns can be edited; any other status is
`409 invalid_state`.

post.description:
Queues the campaign for sending (`202`), now or at `schedule_at`. A
campaign that cannot be launched is `422 launch_rejected`. Send an
`Idempotency-Key` header to retry safely.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Any unique string up to 255 characters, such as a UUID. Retrying with the same key returns the first response (with `Idempotent-Replayed: true`) instead of acting twice.

schedule_at.description: Overrides the campaign's schedule; `null` sends now.

post.description:
Only queued or sending campaigns can be paused; any other status is
`409 invalid_state`.

get.description: Newest first, with each recipient's delivery status.

post.description:
Send a WhatsApp text, approved template, interactive message, Flow, or
media message to a contact (`contact_id`) or directly to an E.164
number (`to`). Send an `Idempotency-Key` header (or `client_message_id`)
to retry safely: a retry returns the original message with
`Idempotent-Replayed: true`.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Any unique string up to 255 characters, such as a UUID. Retrying with the same key returns the first response (with `Idempotent-Replayed: true`) instead of acting twice.

get.description:
Most recently active first. Filter by `channel`, `status` and
`assigned_to` (a user id).

parameters.name: assigned_to
parameters.description: User id of the assigned agent.

get.description:
Messages per channel between `from` and `to` (dates, `YYYY-MM-DD`;
default the last 30 days, at most 366 days).

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: First day, `YYYY-MM-DD`. Defaults to 29 days ago.

get.description:
Conversations resolved over time and the channel mix between `from`
and `to` (same range rules as message volume).

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: First day, `YYYY-MM-DD`. Defaults to 29 days ago.

get.description:
Sent, delivered, read and failed counts of one campaign, delivery over
time and the most common failure reasons.

code.description: Stable, machine-readable error code. Branch on this, never on `message`.

message.description: Human-readable explanation. May change without notice.

content.description:
The notification's own fields (title, body, links), by type.
Not named `data`: that key is the response envelope's.

rules.description: Filter rules of a dynamic segment.

client_message_id.description:
Retrying with the same key never sends twice (scoped to the
recipient conversation in this organization).

template.description:
Canonical template send shape. Parameter objects are intentionally
forwarded to Meta so headers, URL/quick-reply/Flow buttons,
currency, date-time and media parameters remain supported.

interactive.description:
Meta interactive objects are validated structurally below. The
allow-list prevents this endpoint becoming an arbitrary Graph API
proxy while retaining every interactive family Orqo supports.

flow.description:
Developer-friendly Flow form; converted to Meta's interactive
Flow object by the sender service.

media.description:
Media can be an existing Meta media id, a public HTTPS link, or a
multipart upload. `attachment` is accepted as an inbox-compatible
alias for `file`.

BadRequest.description: Malformed request, e.g. an invalid Idempotency-Key (`bad_request`, `invalid_idempotency_key`).

Unauthenticated.description: Missing, invalid or expired API token (`unauthenticated`).

PaymentRequired.description: No active subscription (`subscription_required`) or a plan limit is reached (`plan_limit_reached`).

Forbidden.description: The token may not do this (`forbidden`, `organization_required`, `capability_required`).

NotFound.description: The resource does not exist in this organization (`not_found`).

Conflict.description: The resource's state does not allow this (`invalid_state`), or the Idempotency-Key clashes (`idempotency_key_reused`, `idempotency_in_progress`).

ValidationFailed.description: A field is invalid (`validation_failed`); `error.fields` lists the messages per field.

RateLimited.description: Too many requests (`rate_limited`). Wait for `Retry-After` seconds.
